text:
Oliver Grant: Quick ops thread to align on the marketplace + partner launch. Scope: AWS/GCP/Azure listings, one hardware partner bench (NVIDIA), two SI integration demos, landing page, PR + social. Objective: clean handoffs and one source of truth.
Sofia Martinez: propose a soft-launch/internal preview the week before public to partner PMs and sales. helps catch issues.
Devon Cho: timeline: aiming for public announce Wed Aug 11 09:00 PT. embargo for partners Tue Aug 10 08:00 PT. marketplace certs need to be in by Jul 31.
Hannah Lee: marketing assets needed: hero headline, hero stat, three feature cards, partner tiles, bench graphic, 3 screenshots, one explainer GIF, press kit pdf. Draft assets by Jul 20.
Oliver Grant: owners: AWS/Azure -> Devon, GCP -> Sofia, Marketing -> Hannah, Partner outreach & quotes -> Oliver. Legal review -> partner-bot will notify.
partner-bot: Reminder: upload quote approvals and logo MOUs to /legal/partner-approvals by Jul 15 for 72h review.
Sofia Martinez: marketplace nuance: GCP Marketplace needs containerized product + test account. I can prepare the GCP package if we have a test tenant. who owns test setup?
Devon Cho: infra can provide a sandbox tenant. i'll open a ticket with eng-infra today.
Hannah Lee: bench graphic question: single combined hero stat or partner-specific tiles? marketing prefers a single headline stat + partner tiles with smaller callouts.
Oliver Grant: agree single hero stat for broad messaging, partner tiles for partner pages. partner quotes optional but useful. i'll request quotes from NVIDIA and HPE this week.
Sofia Martinez: SI demos: two flows — 1) provisioning + onboarding (10m) 2) model reroute + failover demo (8m). need scripts and short video clips. who will lead demos?
Devon Cho: SI demos -> I'll coordinate with platform eng and Sam (solutions) to build demo scripts. target draft scripts by Jul 10.
Hannah Lee: PR plan: embargoed release + partner co-pitches. draft press release by Jul 18, partner review window 48 hours. social cards + partner variants by Jul 22.
partner-bot: Calendar event "Marketplace + Partners Launch" weekly standup starting Jun 30, Thursdays 11am PT. Owners invited.
Oliver Grant: risks: marketplace cert delays, partner quote signoff, sandbox availability, export/compliance for hardware. Mitigation: staggered listing + backup blog content.
Sofia Martinez: technical checklist for listings: product icon (512px), three screenshots, short description (120 chars), long description (500 chars), privacy pointer, security attestation. I'll assemble a template.
Devon Cho: action items: 1) Devon submit AWS/Azure packages by Jul 25 2) Sofia prepare GCP bundle by Jul 25 3) Hannah deliver draft assets by Jul 20 4) Oliver get partner logo/quote approvals by Jul 15 5) Legal review by Jul 15.
Hannah Lee: uploading initial screenshots to /shared/marketing/marketplace today.
Oliver Grant: scheduling: partner dry-run Aug 3, internal preview Aug 7, public launch Aug 11. please block calendars.
Sofia Martinez: small ask — can marketing include a short FAQ about marketplace billing differences? helps reduce support tickets.
Hannah Lee: yes i'll draft an FAQ section and cloud-specific notes.
Devon Cho: i'll escalate marketplace support tickets if certs are delayed.
partner-bot: Note: set deadline reminders 7 days before each milestone.
Oliver Grant: thanks everyone. i'll compile a short RACI and drop in the shared folder tonight. Tag me with any blockers. :rocket:
